essence: The deity is identified by bearing a peacock flag, a goad, and a boon-giving aspect.
This deity should be established in villages, temples, and similar places for success.
The prescribed number varies by age or context, with nine elsewhere or all accepted everywhere.
The mantra component is formed by joining the third element of Śarva with the sixth vowel.
The Subrahmanya mantra begins with praṇava, uses the dative form of the name, and ends with namas.
